name: B10-0198/2024 (Renew) – Reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep backing Ukraine against Russia's war and to step up that support. It asks for more weapons, including long-range missiles and air defence, and for tougher sanctions on Russia and on countries helping it, especially North Korea, Iran and China. It also wants the frozen Russian assets used for Ukraine. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Parliament urges more military aid and sanctions; no law changes yet.
- It affects Ukraine, Russia, North Korea, Iran, China and EU governments.
- Next, EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these calls.
